inputs.name: Samples
inputs.description: One row per tissue section. For Xenium, add the sample name and its .tar.gz.

samplesheet.name: Sections

columns.name: pair_id
columns.description: Sample name. Used to name every result.

columns.name: xenium_dir
columns.description: Raw Xenium output bundle (outs/), uploaded as one .tar, .tar.gz, .tgz or .zip.

columns.name: merscope_dir
columns.description: Only for MERSCOPE or paired mode: raw MERSCOPE region export as one archive.

columns.name: merscope_z_range
columns.description: Only for MERSCOPE: z planes to use, e.g. 1-2. Blank uses 0-6.

columns.name: merscope_channels
columns.description: Only for MERSCOPE: image channels. Blank uses DAPI,PolyT.

samplesheet.description: Each row runs the whole pipeline: segmentation, QC, MECR, clustering, MapMyCells cell types and MENDER spatial domains.

inputs.name: Pipeline options
inputs.description: Preset for Xenium human brain on this server. Change only if your data differ.

analysis_mode.name: Analysis mode
analysis_mode.description: Which platform each section has. paired needs both a MERSCOPE and a Xenium export.

species.name: Species
species.description: Only the human brain atlas is installed on this server; mouse needs the mouse atlas first.

xenium_channels.name: Xenium channels
xenium_channels.description: Image channel(s) Cellpose segments, comma-separated. 0 is DAPI (nuclei).

xenium_min_qv.name: Xenium min QV
xenium_min_qv.description: Drop transcripts with a quality score below this. 20 is the 10x standard.

cellpose_gpu.name: Cellpose on GPU
cellpose_gpu.description: This server has no GPU; leave off.

clustering_squidpy_use_gpu.name: Clustering on GPU
clustering_squidpy_use_gpu.description: This server has no GPU; leave off.

inputs.name: Advanced options
inputs.description: Analysis settings. The presets suit Xenium brain sections.

mapmycells_reference_mode.name: MapMyCells reference
mapmycells_reference_mode.description: whole_brain uses the installed atlas and takes minutes. region builds a frontal-cortex reference and adds about 2 hours (downloads about 38 GB).

analysis_segmentation.name: Segmentation
analysis_segmentation.description: Cell boundaries the analyses use: proseg_hybrid, reseg, original_seg, proseg_mask, or all (comma-separated).

mender_radius_um.name: MENDER radius (µm)
mender_radius_um.description: Neighbourhood size for spatial domains. Larger gives broader domains.

enable_alignment.name: Align paired sections
enable_alignment.description: Paired mode only: register MERSCOPE onto Xenium (VALIS).

outputs.name: Cell types by marker genes
outputs.description: Each cell coloured by the cell type its cluster's marker genes point to.

outputs.name: Cell types on tissue (Allen atlas)
outputs.description: Each cell named by MapMyCells against the Allen atlas, and how many of each type.

outputs.name: Tissue domains on tissue
outputs.description: MENDER domains on the section, each domain's size and the cell type that dominates it.

outputs.name: Annotation summary
outputs.description: The counts behind the three annotation figures.

outputs.name: Platform comparison tables
outputs.description: Per-gene counts on MERSCOPE against Xenium, raw and normalised.

outputs.name: Platform comparison metrics
outputs.description: Summary of how well the two platforms agree.

outputs.name: Clustered cells
outputs.description: AnnData with clusters and UMAP, one per platform and segmentation.

outputs.name: Cell types
outputs.description: Allen cell type and confidence for every cell.

outputs.name: Cell types (AnnData)
outputs.description: Clustered AnnData annotated with MapMyCells cell types.

outputs.name: Spatial domains
outputs.description: AnnData with each cell's MENDER spatial domain.

outputs.name: MECR summary
outputs.description: Mutually exclusive co-expression rate: a segmentation error measure.

outputs.name: Spatial gene autocorrelation
outputs.description: Genes whose positions are more clustered or spread than chance.

outputs.name: Alignment transform
outputs.description: Transform from the moving to the fixed section.

outputs.name: Cell types on tissue
outputs.description: Each cell coloured by its broad cell class, drawn on the section.

outputs.name: Cell type UMAP
outputs.description: UMAP of all cells coloured by broad cell class.

outputs.name: Spatial domains on tissue
outputs.description: MENDER spatial domains drawn on the section.

outputs.name: Spatial domain UMAP
outputs.description: UMAP of cell neighbourhoods coloured by MENDER domain.
